title: AUREN Basic Operating Mode implementation tracker

tasks.title: Baseline canonical runtime and department ownership map
acceptance: Map existing TaskPlan, StateGraph, ExecutionController, RuntimeExecutionGuard, ProgressJournal, recovery ledger and Evidence Envelope owners
Identify duplicate state machines and existing dashboard projections
Record current-main file/test references and external gaps

tasks.title: Define versioned gap event and record contract
acceptance: TECH/INTENT/COGNITIVE records include stable identity, plan/intent digest, severity, evidence, owner, remediation, timebox and resolution evidence
Append-only events use existing ProgressJournal and Evidence Envelope
Cross-store reconciliation and schema compatibility tests pass
tasks.rollback: Disable gap event projection; preserve journal and prior schema

tasks.title: Implement three-axis readiness assessment before planning/dispatch
acceptance: Intent contract is explicit and testable
Technology readiness checks code, tools, provider contracts, permissions, versions and rollback
Cognitive readiness checks context freshness, assumptions, contradictions, uncertainty and verifier independence
Blocking gaps deny consequential dispatch
tasks.rollback: Feature-flag off assessment only; canonical safety guards remain active

tasks.title: Enforce bounded research and POC budgets in canonical supervisor
acceptance: Research <=45m and POC <=90m in basic mode
At most one research pass, one POC and one correction iteration
Budget persists across restart; no reset by retry/rename
Expiry emits decision, gap log and next safe action
tasks.rollback: Disable optional research/POC lane; retain supervisor attempt/deadline controls

tasks.title: Add department accountability and remediation paths to TaskPlan
acceptance: Every actionable gap has exactly one accountable owner
Dependencies, acceptance, due timebox, escalation and rollback owner are durable
Handoffs preserve policy, evidence, budget and unresolved gaps
tasks.rollback: Revert plan projection; preserve journaled gap events

tasks.title: Derive dashboard gap and status views from durable state
acceptance: Dashboard shows dimension, severity, owner, age, budget, blocker and next safe action
State derives from durable records, never worker prose
Stale/missing projection is visible and cannot imply completion
tasks.rollback: Return to existing durable status projection

tasks.title: Add end-to-end and fault-injection tests
acceptance: Restart at every gap and research/POC boundary
Cancellation/deadline and termination uncertainty tests
Duplicate dispatch, stale intent/plan, split writes and conflicting adoption tests
Verifier self-approval, missing/stale/contradictory evidence tests
Dashboard matches durable state
tasks.rollback: No rollout until regression suite passes

tasks.title: Run paired basic-mode benchmark and tune false-blocker rate
acceptance: Compare with baseline without three-axis scan
Measure detection recall, false blockers, missed blockers, time-to-first-safe-action, completion quality, cost and latency
Retain failed/negative outcomes and confidence intervals
No capability claim from internal CI alone
tasks.rollback: Keep feature flag disabled if regression or cost threshold is exceeded

tasks.title: Canary rollout, operator runbook and rollback rehearsal
acceptance: Operator-approved canary profile and deployment identity
Fresh-process resume and rollback receipts
Post-cutover reconciliation and independent evidence check
tasks.rollback: Restore prior profile and preserve all pre/post-cutover state

tasks.title: Publish evidence-backed completion matrix and close #696 slice
acceptance: Each FR/NFR mapped to implementation and test evidence
Implementation, CI, deployment and independent verification statuses separated
Open gaps and next safe actions retained
tasks.rollback: Keep tracker open; do not close acceptance issues prematurely

tasks.title: Operator-controlled state migration, resume, rollback and reconciliation
acceptance: Signed operator identity and staging host
Dry-run/apply manifest and full SQLite integrity evidence
Fresh-process resume
Rollback to preserved root
Post-cutover write reconciliation
tasks.rollback: Keep both state roots preserved; no destructive cleanup

tasks.title: Provider-native idempotency and authoritative lookup validation
acceptance: Provider documentation/configuration and real operation IDs
Injected timeout/connection-loss after provider acceptance
Authoritative lookup proves applied/not-applied outcome
Independent review of retained receipts
tasks.rollback: Block new consequential dispatch when outcome is unknown

tasks.title: Independent evaluator and sealed holdout campaign
acceptance: Evaluator and corpus custody outside candidate trust domain
External signing authority
Retained campaign results and reproducible manifests
tasks.rollback: No promotion; retain candidate as unverified

non_claims: This tracker is a specification, not evidence that runtime integration is complete.
No operator identity, provider outcome, production isolation, independent evaluator custody or rollback success is inferred.
No harness, extension, model or capability is promoted by default.
